description: This file defines the 'Basic' class, which extends SugarBean and provides methods related to email address management and basic object behaviors within the SuiteCRM system. It includes class properties, constructor, and several methods for retrieving and validating email addresses.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: Represents a basic CRM entity with email handling capabilities, extending the SugarBean class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the Basic object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object's name.

methods.name: getEmailAddressFromEmailField
methods.description: Retrieves an EmailAddress object associated with the specified email field, with validation and retrieval logic.

methods.name: getEmailAddressId
methods.description: Retrieves the email address ID for a given email field, including validation, cleanup, and lookup logic.

methods.name: validateSugarEmailAddressField
methods.description: Validates that the provided email field name is a string and matches the expected pattern.

methods.name: cleanUpEmailAddress
methods.description: Normalizes an email address by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.
